<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsDisclosureAbstract', window );"><strong>Intangible Asset, Goodwill and Other [Abstract]</strong></a></td>

<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_IntangibleAssetsDisclosureTextBlock', window );">INTANGIBLE ASSETS</a></td>
<td class="text"><p id="xdx_80E_eus-gaap--IntangibleAssetsDisclosureTextBlock_zmoTVlFWkUE5" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>NOTE 4: <span id="xdx_829_z2A8I3rZrNEf">INTANGIBLE ASSETS</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company capitalizes costs associated with
software developed for internal use, including payroll for employees directly involved in development and external consulting fees, once
the project has reached the application development stage in accordance with ASC 350-40. &#160;Amortization is computed using the straight-line
method over an estimated useful life of <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife_iI_dtY_c20260630__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_zIuK3Q7kRsFh" title="Estimated useful life">3</span>&#8211;<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife_iI_dtY_c20260630__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zPp2jdbNasza" title="Estimated useful life">5</span> years.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Patent and trademark values are reviewed annually
for potential impairment. The Company determined that no impairment is currently warranted. The Company recognized amortization expense
of $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--AdjustmentForAmortization_c20260401__20260630_zbTNP8JVXbU3" title="Amortization expense">2,631</span> and $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--AdjustmentForAmortization_c20260101__20260630_z6bWhYopS1u7" title="Amortization expense">21,512</span> for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 and $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--AdjustmentForAmortization_c20250401__20250630_z4GypGCxWY95" title="Amortization expense">12,000</span> and $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--AdjustmentForAmortization_c20250101__20250630_zlktsrDlNoGg" title="Amortization expense">24,202</span> for the three and six months ended June
30, 2025, respectively.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The intangibles carrying amount as of June
30, 2026 and December 31, 2025 and amortization expense for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and the year ended December 31, 2025 are
as follows:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>
